title: Tall whites' two-month trip to a star near Arcturus, so craft must exceed light speed

tellings.quote: And this was in the mid 1960s. This was like in 1965, the late summer. And there was a six-w weekek or two-month period

plain: In late summer 1965, the tall pale beings called the "tall whites" made a round trip of about six weeks to two months to a star near Arcturus, a bright star far from Earth, which means their craft must travel faster than light. Charles Hall, a former Air Force man who says he worked alongside these beings at Indian Springs, Nevada, tells this from his own experience, naming figures he calls the Teacher and the Tour Guide.
